The company is severely distressed, as evidenced by a negative net income (-$23M), negative retained earnings (-$1,065M), and negative shareholders' equity (-$496M) indicating technical insolvency and cumulative balance sheet erosion. Furthermore, operational profitability is extremely thin relative to its revenue base (EBIT margin of ~2.6%), leaving virtually no cushion to service its heavy liability load of $2,149M. Consequently, the issuer faces substantial credit risk and a high likelihood of default or restructuring without significant external intervention.
